DLC2313:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...As I've mentioned before, so much in this world is made up of three elements.」

DLC2313:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Spirit, skill and body... No climax, no punchline, no meaning... Red, blue and yellow... Tall, high-paid and highly educated... And love, guts and encounters...」

DLC2313:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I'm about to tell takes place just after $$セツコ$$ was abducted.」

DLC2313:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「First $$スズネ$$, and now $$セツコ$$... Surely it's the adults' job to give the young people reeling from that shock a good kick into gear.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:5.en:
$$隼人$$
「It's hardly surprising. That $$バルビエル$$ abducted two of our friends in quick succession.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:6.en:
$$弁慶$$
「$$スズネ$$ and $$セツコ$$ were like big sisters to the youngsters. They must be badly shaken.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But if we stay like this, we're playing right into that sneaky scorpion bastard's hands.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Isn't it obvious? At a time like this, nothing beats getting your body moving.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:11.en:
$n
「Please give us a good kick into gear.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:14.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It's time you stood on your own. Think about how to train yourselves.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:15.en:
$$竜馬$$
「The ones I'm going to whip into shape are...」

DLC2313:3:t_2:18.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Your mental state directly affects your fighting strength. You can't fight like this.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:19.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'll put you through some special training.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:20.en:
$$アンディ$$
「The demon $$竜馬$$ picked us personally?!」

DLC2313:3:t_2:21.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「We appreciate the thought, but we'll pass. We decide our own training program.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What would Supreme Commander $$不動$$ say if he were here?」

DLC2313:3:t_2:24.en:
$$カイエン$$
「...It pains me to admit it, but he'd probably say the same thing as you, $$竜馬$$...」

DLC2313:3:t_2:26.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「Lord $$カイエン$$ admitted defeat...」

DLC2313:3:t_2:27.en:
$$アマタ$$
「That... isn't something to be ashamed of.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:29.en:
$$アマタ$$
「This is no time to put on a brave face. Right now, we need to admit our own weakness and climb back up from there.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:31.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Looks like you understand the situation, $$アマタ$$.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:32.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It doesn't matter what Supreme Commander $$不動$$ would say. Let's get stronger because we choose to.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:33.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's good, $$アマタ$$. Now you've got a face worth training.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:34.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I'm not letting $$アマタ$$ get all the glory.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:35.en:
$$カイエン$$
「$$アクエリオン$$ brings the $$エレメント$$s' powers together. Unless we all get stronger, $$アクエリオン$$ can't show its true strength.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:36.en:
$$隼人$$
「Looks like your minds are made up.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:37.en:
$$弁慶$$
「We'll see this through with you. You'll learn there are three demons aboard $$ゲッター$$.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:40.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I can't imagine you need someone to fire you up at this point...」

DLC2313:3:t_2:41.en:
$$赤木$$
「It's not just $$２１世紀警備保障$$ taking part.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:42.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...Got it. I'll leave that side to you.」

DLC2313:3:t_2:43.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's go, you lot! Be ready in ten minutes!」

DLC2313:3:t_3:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're not on watch after this, right?」

DLC2313:3:t_3:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then let's take a little break. The beer's cold.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:8.en:
$$青山$$
「Sorry, $$シンジ$$. For adults, beer comes before dinner.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:9.en:
$$赤木$$
「Of course, we'll eat dinner, too.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:12.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... It's a grown-up privilege, meow.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:13.en:
$$いぶき$$
（Those two really do seem strangely worldly at times...）

DLC2313:3:t_3:14.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I'll save pleasures like that for a little later.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:15.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Let's go, $$シンジ$$. I hear tonight's dinner is $$郁絵$$'s special hamburg steak.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:17.en:
$$カイエン$$
「You haven't smiled like that in a while.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:18.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Looks like $$シンジ$$ still prefers dumplings to flowers... Food before romance.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:20.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Then in that respect, $$アマタ$$ is just a little more grown-up than $$シンジ$$.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:22.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Oh, stop it, $$シュレード$$...」

DLC2313:3:t_3:23.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Ah... You can't spring a look like that on me out of nowhere...」

DLC2313:3:t_3:25.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「You still can't keep your feet on the ground.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:26.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Don't be like that. It's the source of $$アマタ$$'s fighting power, after all.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:28.en:
$$カヲル$$
「It really is different for everyone.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:29.en:
$$シンジ$$
（What... am I fighting for now...?）

DLC2313:3:t_3:30.en:
$$シンジ$$
（If I keep moving forward, even a little at a time, will I understand someday...?）

DLC2313:3:t_3:33.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Let's go, $$シンジ$$. Everyone's waiting for us.」

DLC2313:3:t_3:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...A boy climbs the steps toward adulthood little by little. No matter how endless and steep the climb, one step at a time...」

DLC2313:3:t_3:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, what a wonderful thing. I'm especially interested in $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$ taking their next step toward adulthood.」

review.context: Ryouma trains the Aquarion Elements after Setsuko's abduction; Akagi arranges help for the Evangelion pilots. Afterwards, dinner and teasing show renewed morale.
decisions: The opening list retains the no-climax/no-punchline/no-meaning joke and the three desirable partner traits.
MIX's feet-off-the-ground comment is literal as well as teasing, because Amata levitates when emotionally excited.
Food before romance preserves the proverb's explanation in Zessica's own line.
